subject: classical-statistical-mechanics

sources.title: Retained CSM full source designs, current authored carriers and repaired source contracts
sources.extent: Entire original track and audit report; original prose scaffold and pathway inventory examined; relevant actual supplier Statement/Definition and proof portions listed in suppliers.json. The many original worker files remain mandatory full-source obligations, not a claim of fresh complete rereading.
sources.classification: Historical approved scope plus actual local mathematics; old source-reading assertions are historical, not newly certified.

sources.title: Hugo Touchette, The large deviation approach to statistical mechanics
sources.extent: PDF pp. 1–3 contents/scope; p.19 Varadhan principle; pp.24–26 finite empirical measures and limitations of cumulant methods; source map for Sections V.C–V.E ensemble duality. Inspected theorem and derivation portions, not every page or bibliography source.
sources.classification: Established LDP review; use compact bounded-continuous Laplace theorem with independent planned proof, avoiding unrestricted heuristic Gartner–Ellis conclusions.

sources.title: Bertini, De Sole, Gabrielli, Jona-Lasinio and Landim, Macroscopic fluctuation theory
sources.extent: Introduction action and microscopic-scope qualification, PDF pp.2–3; transport coefficients and Section V.D boundary-driven SSEP formulas, PDF pp.24–25. Reviewed exact normalization D=1, chi=rho(1-rho) and action 1/4 convention; Section VIII.H identified as future microscopic-LDP proof route, not fully read or locally proved.
sources.classification: Framework with proved stochastic-model cases; not general Newtonian hydrodynamic derivation. New equilibrium action identities proved directly; no new dynamical LDP claim.

sources.title: David Tong, Statistical Physics, chapter 5 Phase Transitions
sources.extent: Chapter retrieved; inspected sections 5.2.2–5.2.3 critical exponents/mean-field limitations and 5.5 Gaussian Landau–Ginzburg fluctuations. Mathematical Gaussian/scaling conclusions developed directly; no interacting universality theorem borrowed.
sources.classification: Physical framework, approximations and soluble Gaussian calculations distinguished.

sources.title: Levin and Peres with Wilmer, Markov Chains and Mixing Times, second edition
sources.extent: Full PDF retrieved; Chapter 25 introduction and monotone CFTP algorithm, PDF pp.366–370 (printed pp.350–354) inspected, including shared past randomness and runtime caveats. Coupling chapter locations used for proof planning, not claimed full-book reading.
sources.classification: Established finite-chain sampling and exact coupling; no blanket rapid-mixing or critical-complexity result.

sources.title: Daniel Ueltschi, Cluster expansions and correlation functions
sources.extent: PDF pp.1–3: abstract setup, Theorem 1, equations (3)–(8), rooted-cluster induction and the restriction |1+zeta|<=1.
sources.classification: Established repulsive/abstract polymer criterion. Does not by itself justify attractive stable-potential expansion.

sources.title: Poghosyan and Ueltschi, Abstract cluster expansion with applications to statistical mechanical systems
sources.extent: PDF pp.1–3 assumptions 1/2 and Theorem 2.1; Section 3 classical gas stability and explicit fugacity bound; Section 6 forest majorant proof portions on PDF pp.13–14. Complete stable tree proof remains future local authoring obligation.
sources.classification: Established stable-interaction cluster expansion; conjectural combined criterion equation (2.6) expressly not used.

sources.title: Beffara and Duminil-Copin, The self-dual point of the two-dimensional random-cluster model is critical for q>=1
sources.extent: PDF pp.1–4 Theorems 1–4 and boundary definition; Section 2 Theorem 5 and gluing outline; Section 3 Theorem 12 influence bound and its referral to Graham–Grimmett. These are actual bounded source readings, not a claim to have read the external influence proof.
sources.classification: Established exact square-lattice threshold and subcritical exponential decay. Historical open-problem discussion is not adopted as current status.

scope: Only named extents were actually inspected. Sources locate proofs and assumptions; they are not active external-reference fallbacks. Full local proof authoring and native review remain required.
